title: Issue (out-of-scope capture: bug or plan)
description: A queue that persists defects and opportunities found during work but outside the session scope, in a form that another session can start on. skills/dev-docs/knowledge/issue.md is the source of truth for the content contract and for the filing, triage and closure decisions.

issue_type.description: bug = a deviation from an existing expectation (spec/test/declared invariant). plan = a new opportunity, an improvement, or a task not yet started.

subject_paths.description: Repo-relative paths of the subject. dev-evidence recalls the issue by their overlap with the change surface.

disposition_target.description: The doc ID that identifies what resolved the issue (the change that resolved it / the ADR / design it was promoted to). On the transition to done, at least one of this and disposition_reason is required.

disposition_reason.description: What was fixed when the issue was resolved without opening a change, or the reason for rejected. Required on the transition to rejected.
